intro: One scoop of sayur lemak labu is roughly 150 kcal. Most of the calories come from the santan. The pumpkin itself is moderate in calories.

variants.name: Sayur lemak labu with fresh prawns
Masak lemak labu with ikan masin
Labu masak lemak with light santan

diet: Yes, pumpkin has fibre and a natural sweetness. It's the santan that raises the calories, so control the gravy. One scoop with a protein dish and moderate rice is still okay. If you already have another santan dish, pick just one.
tips: Take more pumpkin, less santan gravy.
Don't pick two santan dishes on one plate. Balance with something grilled or a soup.
At home, use light santan or mix it with water for a lighter gravy.

swap.name: Steamed pumpkin or pumpkin stir-fried with garlic
swap.why: Same pumpkin without santan, so the fat drops a lot and the pumpkin's sweetness shines through.

faq.a: Pumpkin has a little natural sugar but also fibre. In one scoop, the carbs are moderate and fit into a balanced plate.

faq.q: Why does my pumpkin turn mushy when cooking?
faq.a: Pumpkin cooks fast. Cut bigger pieces and add them when the gravy is already boiling, then simmer briefly.
For some types, yes, if washed well. But many people remove it because it's tough. Up to your preference.
